name: DODO V2 (DVM / Crowdpooling) init() exploit: two bots front-ran the real attacker, returned funds
race_type_reason: Antelope's flashLoan+init() tx (index 4, 243 gwei) calls pool.init() with calldata byte-identical to the attacker's pending tx and drains the pool the attacker had staged one block earlier; the attacker's tx at index 176 (132 gwei) in the same block reverted. Ordering is by gas price in the public mempool.
one_liner: Antelope, a generic flash-loan bot, replayed the DODO attacker's init() call at index 4 of block 12000022 and took 955,815 WSZO + 259,939 USDT; the attacker's tx at index 176 reverted. Antelope later returned most of its takes. Pre-Merge, in-block evidence only.

attack_txs.role: stage: moves 965,470.24 fake FDO + 262,565.01 fake FUSDT into pool 0xfb609b68 (131 gwei)
attack tx: flashLoan + callback init(FDO,FUSDT,...) on the staged pool; reverted because Antelope had already drained it

mempool_note: In-block evidence only: pre-Merge (March 2021), mempool-dumpster starts 2023-08-07, so no first-seen time exists for the attacker's tx. The race is decided by gas price (243 vs 132 gwei), not by a builder auction; no coinbase payments in any tx.

trigger.note: No mempool first-seen exists (pre-Merge, no archive). The attacker's stage tx landed in block 12000020 and his attack tx 0x4bc4ace3 was in the same block 12000022 as Antelope's; the stage (fake tokens sitting in the pool) was visible on chain two blocks earlier.

attacker_block_note: Attacker's attack tx 0x4bc4ace3 landed in the SAME block (index 176, 132 gwei) and reverted behind Antelope's index-4 tx. The attacker's stage tx was in block 12000020.

loot.loot_note: incident.json states no USD value for this pool's loot. The 259,939 USDT leg is about $259.9K at par; the WSZO leg is unpriced. DODO's postmortem totals roughly $3.8M across all pools. priority_fee_paid_eth is the whole gas fee (pre-London: gasUsed x gasPrice = 183,815 x 243.1 gwei); there are no coinbase payments. This row covers the Antelope tx only; the wider incident (other pools, Cheetah's USDT/wCRES) is in bots_other and incident.json.

fate.returned_to: 0xdad3e839ba4a48faf54f3aa187d8b6b8646e6224 (recovery wallet per incident.json; presumed DODO side)
fate.returned_desc: Antelope's EOA returned, on 2021-03-10 00:26-00:39 UTC (blocks 12007525-12007572), 955,815.54 WSZO (all of this row's WSZO), 101,548.43 ETHA, 1,000 wCRES, 296,009 USDT and 114.50682 ETH to 0xdad3e839 (verified in the saved Etherscan files). Antelope took 259,939 + 326,070 USDT in the two DODO races, so the USDT return is not a full match and was not reconciled. Cheetah's ~$1.89M return is reported by DODO's postmortem; no matching on-chain return was found. Token returns are not converted to ETH here.

fate.public_statement: DODO postmortem (via ChainCatcher translation): 'Mr. Antelope' anonymously emailed on March 10 offering to return funds (about $1.2 million); 'Mr. Cheetah' returned $1.89 million around March 9 21:00 Beijing time. Postmortem calls Antelope's bot a 'Universal Trading Bot' that automatically front-ran Hippo.
fate.return_status_rule: returned = everything went back to the victim side except a bounty the victim agreed to or offered; partial = some came back, otherwise; none = known zero within the documented search window; unknown = unresolved

reported only, no on-chain return tx located

discrepancies: initial incident notes placed Cheetah at 12000165/12001452; on chain Cheetah's wins are blocks 12000167 (index 1, tx 0x75d4765d) and 12000171 (index 3, tx 0xa8d03049). Block 12000165 holds the ATTACKER's bypass attack (index 3); 12001452 is Cheetah losing to Antelope on a different pool.
Antelope's 12001452 tx (93,148 gwei, 8.128 ETH fee) is not the Hippo race; the postmortem's '90,000 gwei / 8 ETH' folklore refers to it.
The 114.5 ETH Antelope returned is not tied to any priced take in the saved data (ETH-equivalent of the token returns is unknown).
evidence_notes: pool.init() (selector 0x5039972a) calldata in Antelope's tx 0xff9b3b2c and the attacker's reverted tx 0x4bc4ace3 is byte-identical (522 hex chars each, same pool 0xfb609b68, incl. the attacker's fake FDO/FUSDT) -- checked from site/raw/rpc/trace_<tx>.json.

The flashLoan frames differ only in assetTo/data and by 99 wei in amounts: Antelope's tx is an adapted replay with its own contract and callback, not a byte copy (incidents/dodo-v2-2021/incident.json bots[0].replay_evidence).

Block 12000022: Antelope index 4 at 243.1 gwei (status success), attacker index 176 at 132 gwei (reverted); the attacker had staged the fake tokens in block 12000020 (race_12000022.json, race_12000020.json).

Same pattern in block 12000102: Antelope index 0 at 1883 gwei vs the attacker's index 4 at 600 gwei (reverted). Cheetah replayed the attacker's own withdraw calldata in blocks 12000167/12000171 (race_12000167.json, race_12000171.json).
Pre-Merge: no coinbase payments and no mempool archive; ordering is gas-price based.
